topics.purpose: Define each backup artifact/set as explicit evidence of exact source identities, revisions, time, scope, encryption/integrity profile and retention class.

semantics.identity_rule: Each backup has an explicit identity.
semantics.revision_rule: Captured source revision/snapshot point is explicit.
semantics.encryption_rule: Encryption/key reference/profile is explicit where used.
semantics.authority_rule: Backup possession grants no source restore/access authority.

invariants.rule: Release candidate, accepted release, deployment plan, deployment execution, installed artifact, active runtime instance and observed health remain separate identities/states.
Operational convenience, availability pressure, maintenance state, automation, recovery or rollback never silently bypass validation, authorization, integrity, governance or dispatcher boundaries.
